subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate phrase to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

Shahid Bhagat Singh was a patriot __completely.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'through and through'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"completely"** means totally or entirely; to the fullest extent. (पूरी तरह से)

 
 
• **Example: **He was completely exhausted after the marathon.
 
 
 
• **"Through and through" **refers to something that is true in every aspect; thoroughly or completely. (पूरी तरह से)
 
 
• **Example: **She is a kind-hearted person through and through.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'through and through'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **By and by **(धीरे-धीरे): Gradually; after a short period.

 
 
• **Example:** By and by, she started to recover from her illness.
 
 
 
• **Down and out **(बिल्कुल असफल): Lacking funds, resources, or prospects; destitute.
 
 
• **Example: **He found himself down and out after losing his job.
 
 
 
• **Off and on** (कभी-कभी): Intermittently; occasionally.
 
 
• **Example:** It rained off and on throughout the day.

The correct answer is** option 4.**</p
